body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> 3M displayed its new micro professional projector 'MPro 110' at CES 2009.

About the size of a remote control, it connects to most digital video devices to project movies, photos and files. Supporting VGA 640x480 resolution, the MPro 110 uses LED(Light Emitting Diode) illumination, LCOS(Liquid crystal on silicon) imaging and can be powered from its internal battery or a wall outlet.
